name: Fridgimp
look: a crouching little blue imp with an icy crest, curled horns, pointed ears, red eyes, a big round red frostbitten nose, a toothy grin, frosty back spikes and a jagged tail
entry: Its nose is red from frostbite, and it is very proud of it. It creeps into houses on snowy nights to put out the fires and pinch the warm socks drying by the hearth.
how: Wild: uncommon in snowy biomes at night, and on mountain peaks.
Evolves into Freelzebub at level 45 while it's snowing (rain in a freezing biome).
